value.rationale: The Heawood incidence graph is a canonical small flag-transitive finite geometry; the known ordinary matching complex has 16 four-sphere summands but the full quotient retains one rational class. Its integral torsion and fundamental group are genuinely undetermined by that representation-theoretic precursor. Classifying the ordinary geometric orbit space completely as a homotopy S4 resolves both obstructions and supplies a natural independently reproducible topology example.
